title.en: An Act Authorizing the Heirs or Representatives of the Late Agustin De La Pena to Bring Suit Against the Government of the Philippine Islands, and Directing the Attorney General to Appear in Said Suit on the Behalf of the Said Government.

text.en:
The heirs or legal representatives of the late Agustin de la Pena are hereby authorized to bring
suit against the Government of the Philippine Islands, in the Court of First Instance of Manila or Iloilo, within
six months from and after the approval of this Act, to determine their right, if any, to any portion of the funds
deposited in the Insular Treasury in nineteen hundred and one by the military authorities of the United States,
as funds seized from the insurgent forces, and the Attorney General is authorized and directed to appear at
said trial, either himself or through a delegate, on the behalf of the Government of the Philippine Islands to
defend said Government at the same.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, February 28, 1919.
